name: echo packet dodge
description: Proposal, the daemon dodging traffic with the ultracode signature at its climax, 40 cell lattice (12 px cells, the creature at 2x standing on a floor line): gold packets with short amber trails fly in from the right and off the left edge; it leans back from two singles at antenna and head height with its antenna whipped flat, hops a low one with its legs tucked, squashes down under a high one at the visor, then a dark red wall of packets in three lanes comes that it cannot dodge, so it pings, glitch splits twice in ping like ultracode enter, shrinks and echoes into three minis that stand in the wall's three gaps and ping in turn while the volley passes between them, slides back together into one, and shakes off cream dust; nothing ever touches it (the build checks); judge whether the lean, hop and duck read as dodges, whether the split reads as ultracode rather than the creature breaking, and whether the packets read as packets.
